capabilities: show sidebar cards of most linked notes and recent changes
display a clickable section rail with numbered headings
add contents, scroll-to-top, and scroll-to-bottom buttons
show and edit file tags via the Wikiwurzel plugin
disambiguation: Not a tag manager; the tags card only appears when the separate Wikiwurzel plugin is installed.
extras: The Korean section states it is an unofficial plugin unrelated to Namuwiki, which inspired the style.
problem: Obsidian has no wiki-style side panels that show most-linked and recently changed notes with quick numbered heading navigation.

relations.evidence: File tags card (with the Wikiwurzel plugin): shows and edits the tags of the file being viewed
pairs with the Wikibaum theme, which supplies the exact colors

summary: Adds wiki-style sidebar cards (most linked notes, recent changes), a numbered section rail, and contents/scroll buttons to notes.
